Students can enrol on your [[Campuses|campus]] to study. Each of them can take a [[Courses|course]] in which they want to graduate. They can level up their studies to achieve better grades by going to classes or taking [[assignments]]. You can collect extra XP fees every month by levelling up your students. Each student has a learning rate, which is affected by the [[#Mood|student's mood]].
The students either graduate after the [[Courses|course]] ended or quit before it. To keep them on your [[Campuses|campus]], you need to provide them with multiple facilities and entertainment.

==Student Overview==
===Overview===
*'''Course:''' Indicating the student's progress in their [[Courses|chosen field]].
*'''Happiness:''' [[{{PAGENAME}}#Mood|See below]]
*'''Status:''' The student's current focus, whether it be work, rest or play.
*'''Feelings:''' [[{{PAGENAME}}#Feeling|See below]]
*'''Traits:''' [[{{PAGENAME}}#Personality|See below]]

==Mood==
Each student has an overall happiness rating, which will naturally decrease over time, unless their needs are met.

===Needs===
The higher these bars, the more happy the student will be.

*'''Energy:''' Restored by sleeping in a [[Dormitory|Dorm]], [[Coffee Kiosk|coffee]], or some [[Pulpitation Machine|soft drinks]]. Decreases naturally over time.
*'''Healthiness:''' Increased by walking outside, eating from stalls, or using [[Bench Press|fitness equipment]]. Decreased by [[Cheesy Gubbins Machine|junk food]], [[Burp! Machine|soft drinks]] & [[Bar|milkshakes]].
*'''Food:''' Any solid food will suffice to raise this meter, healthy or not. [[Gastronomy|Chefs]] will nibble their homework to keep the pangs away.
*'''Drink:'''  Satisfied by [[Water Cooler|water coolers]], [[Pulpitation Machine|drinks machines]], [[Coffee Kiosk|coffee stalls]] and other [[Bar|liquids vendors]]. Stay hydrated!
*'''Toilet Comfort:''' Does this individual have the shivers? Nobody can learn with the shivers. Decreases with food & drink. Increases with, [[Bathroom|well...]]
*'''Hygiene:'''  Does the pen adhere to this person's gummy hands? Decreases in low hygiene areas, [[Toilet Cubicle|toilets]]. Increase with [[Shower Cubicle|showers]], [[Sink|sinks]] & [[Hand Sanitiser|sanitisers]].
*'''Entertainment:''' All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy. Put some pep in your students steps with [[Meat Wizard Machine|games]], [[Table Football|table football]], [[Events|parties]] and the like.

===Environment===
*'''Attractiveness:''' Reflecting how [[Campuses#Attractiveness|attractive]] the current environment is.
*'''Thermal Comfort:''' Reflecting how close to an [[Campuses#Temperature|ideal temperature]] the current environment is.
*'''Room Prestige:''' Reflecting how [[Rooms#Prestige|impressive]] the current room is.

===Lifestyle===
*'''Accommodation:''' This is a direct reflection of the [[Dormitory]] they're staying in. Crowding, low Attractiveness and/or Prestige there will harm this.
*'''Personal Goals:''' All students will generate Personal Goals over time. This is filled in when they get to see that poster they really wanted.
*'''Clubs:''' This is filled as a student participates in more extracurricular activities and organizations.
*'''Relationships:''' This is filled as a student builds friendships and woos their sweetie. You can provide benches and furniture to help this along.
*'''Tuition Fees:''' At default rates, this meter is at 50% of maximum and trying to fill it would mean certain bankruptcy unless you have other revenue.

===Feelings===
{{Main|Feelings}}
Feelings reflect the current factors affecting students. Most will affect their wellbeing and performance, in positive or negative ways.

==Social Life==
*'''Clubs:''' Displays any clubs the student may be a member of and their status there.
*'''Personal Goals:''' Displays any wants or desires the student may have. These may be objects that can be placed, relationships or academic goals.
*'''Relationships:''' Shows the other students that the student has friendships or romances with.

===Personality===
Please [[{{PAGENAME}}#Archetypes|see above]] for archetypes.

{{Main|Traits}}
Traits are permanent aspects of each student, which can have positive or negative effects on their wellbeing and performance, including how they affect others.

==Academic==
*'''Education:''' Displays the students' current course, year, experience level and current % grade in the course.
*'''Learning Rate:''' This fluctuates depending on student mood, teacher mood, teacher qualifications and experience level vs. difficulty of the subject material. If this gets low, look at their needs, your rooms, your teachers, or whether the student needs [[Private Tuition Room|Private Tuition]] to catch up experience levels.

==Stats==
===Accommodation===
Displays the name of the current Dormitory room the student is assigned to.

===Academic===
*'''Course Fees:''' What the student is paying for their present year of education.
*'''Total Student Debt:''' What the student owes so far, all tuitions, fees and [[Cheesy Gubbins Machine|Cheezy Gubbins]] included. Tuition is expensive, but education ''is priceless.''
*'''Statistics:''' Specific performance relating to classes, [[assignments]], private tuition and personal goals.
